verdict.rationale: A direct probe confirms a downloadable OpenAPI document at https://proa.so/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), which delivers the core of the story. Nothing in the docs describes what API the spec covers, how complete it is, or advertises it to users. missing for 10: first-party documentation of the spec and its scope, evidence of coverage and completeness, independent corroboration.
